position.description:
Wellness Coordinator

On Site | Coconut Creek, FL | Part-Time | 3pm-8pm

About the Role

You are the operational backbone of the AWA program environment. You ensure the day-to-day experience for adolescent clients is safe, structured, and therapeutically consistent — from the moment they arrive to the moment they leave. This role is hands-on, fast-paced, and client-facing, requiring calm under pressure and genuine investment in the teens you serve.

Backgrounds that translate well: Youth Work · Behavioral Health · Education · Case Management · Community Services

What You'll Do

  • Supervise adolescent clients ages 13–17 during sessions, transitions, breaks, and unstructured time
  • Monitor and maintain program safety; respond to escalated behavior using trauma-informed and crisis protocols
  • Support clinicians in maintaining therapeutic schedules and program flow
  • Greet and assist families at drop-off and pick-up with professionalism and warmth
  • Manage front desk responsibilities including phones, attendance, and sign-in/out
  • Complete accurate, same-day documentation including wellness check-ins and incident reports
  • Escalate safety concerns, disclosures, and behavioral flags to the clinical team immediately and appropriately
  • Support program operations with light administrative and organizational tasks

What We're Looking For

  • Experience working with adolescents in a school, clinical, camp, or community setting
  • Demonstrated ability to de-escalate, regulate, and maintain structure without power struggles
  • Strong documentation and incident reporting skills
  • Bilingual required: English and Spanish
  • Emotionally regulated, professional, and consistent under pressure
  • Understands the limits of a non-clinical role — escalates appropriately, never makes independent clinical decisions
  • Students or recent graduates in Psychology, Social Work, Counseling, or related fields strongly encouraged to apply
  • Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent experience considered

AWA is an adolescent mental health organization operating PHP and IOP programs in South Florida. We exist to serve teens and families at their most critical moments — and this role is at the center of that work every day.


Learn More: Adolescent Wellness Academy

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Wellness Coordinator position. With a background in Human Resources, graduate-level social work education, international travel experiences focused on wellness and personal growth, and a strong desire to help others, I believe I would bring compassion, adaptability, and meaningful life experience to this role.

I earned my Master’s degree in Business and began my professional career in Human Resources. However, over time, I realized that Human Resources was not the long-term path that truly fulfilled me. That realization led me to pursue a more people-centered and wellness-focused direction through social work, travel, and hands-on healing environments.

Currently, I am taking a year gap to travel the world and deepen my understanding of wellness, mindfulness, and community care practices across different cultures. I began this journey at Mandalovas Juvenile Center in the suburb of Montevideo, Uruguay, where I spent four months immersed in a wellness-centered environment focused on healing, connection, and holistic well-being. During my time there, I worked with students and community members while also making a strong effort to learn Spanish. Although I am still learning, working closely with the students in Uruguay helped me improve my communication skills and strengthened my appreciation for cultural connection and understanding.

In addition, I completed four classes toward my Master of Social Work (MSW), where I gained foundational knowledge in mental health support, human behavior, communication, and advocacy. I will also be completing an internship at FHE Health, where I look forward to gaining further hands-on experience in a wellness and behavioral health setting.

My experiences traveling throughout the world have expanded my perspective, emotional intelligence, and cultural awareness. I have learned how important connection, empathy, and support are in helping people feel empowered and understood. These experiences, combined with my professional background and education, have prepared me to create welcoming and supportive environments where individuals can thrive.

I would welcome the opportunity to bring my passion for wellness, my professional experience, and my global perspective to your team as a Wellness Coordinator. Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to discussing how my background and experiences align with your organization’s mission.
